name: Asangathit Karmakaar Silai Machine Sahayata Yojana
hard_exclusions: already received sewing machine/equivalent value under another state scheme
received Chief Minister Cycle Assistance Scheme
questions: Are you a registered worker in Chhattisgarh?

question.en: Are you a construction worker registered with the labour board or department?
question.or: ଆପଣ ଶ୍ରମ ବୋର୍ଡ କିମ୍ବା ବିଭାଗରେ ପଞ୍ଜିକୃତ ନିର୍ମାଣ ଶ୍ରମିକ କି?

question.en: Are you a woman between 18 and 50 years of age?
question.or: ଆପଣ ୧୮ରୁ ୫୦ ବର୍ଷ ବୟସର ଜଣେ ମହିଳା କି?

question.en: Do you earn a livelihood by sewing, embroidering, or weaving clothes?
question.or: ଆପଣ ପୋଷାକ ସିଲାଇ, କଢ଼େଇ କିମ୍ବା ବୁଣା କାମରୁ ଜୀବିକା ଅର୍ଜନ କରନ୍ତି କି?

eligibilityCriteria.source_text: [EXCLUSION] already received sewing machine/equivalent value under another state scheme

question.en: Have you already received a sewing machine or its equivalent value under another state scheme?
question.or: ଆପଣ ଅନ୍ୟ ରାଜ୍ୟ ଯୋଜନାରେ ପୂର୍ବରୁ ସିଲାଇ ମେସିନ୍ କିମ୍ବା ତାହାର ସମମୂଲ୍ୟ ପାଇଛନ୍ତି କି?

eligibilityCriteria.source_text: [EXCLUSION] received Chief Minister Cycle Assistance Scheme

question.en: Have you received assistance under the Chief Minister Cycle Assistance Scheme?
question.or: ଆପଣ ମୁଖ୍ୟମନ୍ତ୍ରୀ ସାଇକେଲ୍ ସହାୟତା ଯୋଜନାରେ ସହାୟତା ପାଇଛନ୍ତି କି?
